scope: Read-only source-art research while root owns live native validation. Original provider maps retained under refs; only temporary display thumbnails/crops made under /tmp. No source art authored, Unity/Blender/native input, Assets edits, helper or importer changes.
outcome: No candidate is suitable as an unmodified whole-tile replacement on all existing metal. The seam-free central field of blue_metal_plate is the strongest starting source for quiet painted-steel panels and selected shutter coating. Preserve its real fine scratches, author localized wear against actual hardware, and audition its much smoother roughness. Retain green_metal_rust as a secondary reference/source for selected chip-and-runoff regions only. Reject rusty_painted_metal for existing flat doors and modeled shutter slats because its corrugation is integral to the maps.

provenance.verification: Every complete 4096x4096 original PNG has a verified API MD5, byte count and local SHA256. Provider PNG bit depth retained, including 16-bit color/normal/roughness maps. No source resampling. API metadata and license snapshot retained separately.
provenance.resolutionChoice: Original provider 4K PBR sets matched to current 4K authoring for this source comparison; not a ceiling. Rusty painted/blue offer 16K and green offers 8K, with original URLs/hashes available in files.json. If a chosen derivative requires more source texels, retain the appropriate larger provider maps before authoring rather than stretching the selected 4K patch.

candidates.visualObservation: The actual diffuse has quiet dark-blue coating, fine dragged/single-line scratches, sparse small chips and broad handling scuffs. Matched normal and roughness carry the same marks. Two strong vertical manufactured panel seams and some horizontal junction lines are present; the full source cannot be blindly tiled across existing door/louvre/slat topology.
candidates.decision: Preferred conditional source for the calm coating field; reject full-tile generic assignment.

inspectedCentralRegion.coordinateConvention: Original 4096 PNG, top-left origin, x0,y0,x1,y1; inspection crop only, not a new texture
inspectedCentralRegion.finding: Inspected in diffuse/normal/roughness. Excludes the conspicuous vertical sheet seams and lowest horizontal junction. Fine scratches remain; no broad directional cast shadow or obvious hot specular highlight was seen in this region. This is a source-image inspection, not a neutral-light material render.

candidates.materialUse: First audition two Finery door leaves and selected shutter coating fields, using existing real dimensions. Recolor only intact blue paint to restrained charcoal while retaining chip/oxide hue; do not multiply the whole map darker indiscriminately. Preserve fine albedo variation and matching normal/roughness. Author actual handle/hinge/meeting-strip and lower-contact wear separately. Never tile the same cropped scratch arrangement visibly across all 20 slats.
candidates.roughnessCaution: Source roughness median 0.2813 (5th–95th 0.2138–0.3699), substantially smoother than current v3 median ~0.79. It depicts semi-gloss coating. A direct replacement would change the material class. Preserve it as a control audition; a weathered derivative should add rough coating/dust locally using material-region masks, while allowing handled/burnished zones to remain smoother. Do not raise roughness globally just to suppress light.

candidates.visualObservation: A mostly quiet green coating interrupted by irregular small blisters, scratches, several recognizable puncture/fastener-like spots and short thin downward oxidation runs. This has better cause-and-effect wear than the current noise islands, but its distinctive holes/runs are not the actual shop hardware. The diffuse center crop carries visible highlight/shadow rims on relief while the normal is comparatively soft.
candidates.decision: Secondary localized weathering reference or selected material-region source after neutral-light verification; do not bind the entire 1 m tile to every door and create repeated false holes.
candidates.materialUse: Retain photographic chip-edge/runoff shapes only where a real hinge, fastening or damage site justifies them; leave broad panel centers quiet. Use actual 1 m source scale. Prefer flat paint regions for repaint texture after checking residual lighting.
candidates.roughnessCaution: Median 0.5021 (5th–95th 0.4736–0.5371), all sampled metallic 0. Color relief shading remains a review concern; measured diffuse-normal correlation is not proof of directional light and cannot clear that concern alone.

candidates.visualObservation: Actual normal contains strong periodic red/blue vertical slopes from corrugation across the whole tile. Albedo and roughness carry weathering tied to those folds; lower regions show large peeling/corrosion and manufactured screw-like sites.
candidates.decision: Reject for this existing flat-door/horizontal-slat pass. Do not rotate or enlarge it until ridges approximately fit; that would import false geometry and misalign wear.
candidates.possibleFutureUse: Retained only for a future intentionally corrugated sheet whose modeled pitch/profile matches the source. It is not a source of generic all-over rust for these focal objects.
candidates.roughnessCaution: Median 0.8092 (5th–95th 0.7803–0.9145), all sampled metallic 0. Roughness resembling current material does not make its geometry compatible.

candidates.visualObservation: Retained original diffuse is much finer than the current synthetic coating-loss field: mottled fine oxidation/speckles and subtle scratches on a light gray sheet, with no large corrugation or conspicuous manufactured seam crossing the inspected tile. It is itself rather uniformly weathered, so full-area reuse would not solve construction-specific wear.
candidates.decision: Retain as micro-oxide and roughness source inside localized new damage masks, at its actual 2 m scale. It is not a substitute for authored wear placement.

currentGraphFinding.color: V3 blends retained photographic oxide color at 0.25 inside a predominantly procedural oxide mix, then mixes paint/oxide by generated periodic wear.
currentGraphFinding.normal: Inherited photographic normal-map strength 0.28; v3 adds procedural coating relief.
currentGraphFinding.roughness: V3 is largely authored 0.79 paint / 0.96 oxide with limited smoother abrasion; the original roughness photo is not the main final roughness signal.
currentGraphFinding.scale: The original image-map nodes use the four-metre bake UV directly; this displays the 2 m source twice as large. This is a source-image scale choice, distinct from the correctly mapped four-metre final mesh material.

physicalMappingContract.internalSourceCoordinates: Source repetitions across an unchanged 4 m authoring tile = 4 / sourceTileMetres; keep structural/lip wear masks in world metres separately.
physicalMappingContract.important: These factors establish physical sampling only. They do not authorize repeating photographed seams/holes. Use metric source coordinates in a uniquely authored bake or selectively assigned regions; preserve existing mesh UV0 and 14 cm shutter slat registration. A crop retains its original physical dimensions and must not be stretched to fill a 4 m square.

channelContract.retainedMaps: Diffuse, GL normal, independent 16-bit Rough, AO, Displacement and ARM for every candidate; Green also retains Bump and Spec. DX duplicates omitted because current Unity pipeline uses verified GL normals.
channelContract.observedMetallic: All three candidate ARM blue channels are zero in the systematic every-fourth-texel sample; they represent dielectric paint/oxide. Keep source metal 0, do not assume the word metal means metallic 1. If any genuinely exposed bare-metal accents are separately authored, give them their own semantic mask.
channelContract.roughnessPacking: Keep linear 16-bit Rough original. For a future Unity packed derivative use R=semantic metallic, A=1-Rough with documented quantization; GL normal is linear without a blind green flip. ARM is R=AO,G=roughness,B=metallic; do not bind ARM directly as Unity metallic/smoothness.
channelContract.normalMapping: All current focal metal materials already have _NORMALMAP enabled. This research creates no normal-keyword fix.
channelContract.occlusion: AO retained for provenance and optional independently controlled contact micro-occlusion; do not multiply it into base color to imitate lighting. Displacement is retained as source, not authorization to alter geometry.

lightingAndAcceptance.inspectionResult: No candidate region is certified free of baked illumination by a thumbnail or channel statistic. Corrugated red and whole blue tiles are rejected on concrete geometric-content mismatch. Green diffuse relief shading is a specific follow-up concern. The selected blue central region has no obvious broad cast shadow/hot highlight in the inspected pixels.
lightingAndAcceptance.nextSourceCheck: On the preserved near source in Blender, use neutral base-color view plus the actual PBR maps under two opposed soft light directions. Reject or repair any fixed directional highlight/shadow pattern that remains in albedo. Do not bake colored/specular lighting into a new base map.
lightingAndAcceptance.nativeCheck: Only after source review, compare matched Field Supply/Finery doors and shutter at noon and correctly completed hour 16 reflection state, including moving first-person views. Existing gameplay roots, meshes, colliders, 9 actors and 4 routes must remain unchanged. This audit makes no native, performance or AAA acceptance claim.

evidence.statisticsLimit: Sparse systematic sample at 1024x1024; color/normal RGB inspection via 8-bit PIL display conversion, grayscale roughness retains 16-bit numeric sampling. All source PNG bit depths and full-file hashes are separately verified.
